description: MInGov Peru is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by Helga Treichel (World Bank Group). The Mining Investment and Governance Review (MInGov) is a tool used to systematically diagnose mining governance, improve sector performance, encourage investment, and facilitate engagement by civil society. MInGov data for individual countries are collected from a variety of sources (primary, secondary, and interviews) and made publicly available. Coverage: Peru. It has 1 file in XLS. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
